zh-CN.name: 使用服务
zh-CN.summary: 发现并调用全局目录中已注册的服务
zh-CN.description: 查找并调用全局「应用与服务」目录里登记的 HTTP/MCP 服务，或把其中的 MCP 服务接入本 Agent；本 Agent 已接入的 MCP 服务端不用本技能，按服务端 ID 用 ToolCatalog 检索其工具。Use when 用户要调用目录里的 API 或找尚未接入的现成服务。

en-US.name: Using Services
en-US.summary: Discover and invoke registered services from the catalog
en-US.description: Find and call HTTP/MCP services registered in the global Apps & Services catalog, or connect a catalog MCP service to this Agent. For an MCP server this Agent already has, skip this skill and search ToolCatalog by the server ID. Use when the user asks to call an API from the catalog or to find an existing service this Agent has not connected yet.
